title: New rt_landlord_id reset-arm guard substring is not unique — collides with the consent-changed reject arm
detail: The guard is meant to pin the reset-arm rt_landlord_id clear, but the same substring exists in the consent-changed reject arm. Reverting only the reset-arm clear would leave the guard green — a silent privacy regression (logout within 60s of an unfired identify could re-identify the prior landlord after posthog.reset()).
recommended_fix: Anchor the guard to the reset arm uniquely, e.g. pin 'rt_ph_reset=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax";document.cookie="rt_landlord_id=' (the rt_ph_reset clear immediately precedes rt_landlord_id only in the reset arm), in both Makefile:274 and Dockerfile:133.
